LESSON: ADMINISTRATION OF ZAKAT

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 4
Topic 4.3: Administration of Zakat
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 10

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Administration of Zakat, part of Strand 4 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: Why do Muslims pay zakat? 2. How can zakat be administered with minimal challenges?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. search online or on available reference materials on the collection and distribution of zakat in Kenya and make notes,

2. brainstorm on the challenges in the administration of zakat in Kenya in groups and present in class,

3. discuss the measures that can be put in place to address the challenges of zakat collection and distribution in groups and present in class,

4. listen to a resource person giving a talk on the significance of zakat for socio-economic growth and make notes,

5. calculate the amount of zakat payable on various 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. search online or on available reference materials on the collection and distribution of zakat in Kenya and make notes,
2. brainstorm on the challenges in the administration of zakat in Kenya in groups and present in class,
3. discuss the measures that can be put in place to address the challenges of zakat collection and distribution in groups and present in class,
4. listen to a resource person giving a talk on the significance of zakat for socio-economic growth and make notes,
5. calculate the amount of zakat payable on various 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Administration of Zakat together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Learning to Learn: the skill of working collaboratively enhanced as learners brainstorm on the challenges in the

administration of zakat in Kenya in groups and present in class

• Communication and Collaboration: the skills of listening, speaking, writing and teamwork enhanced as learners calculate

the amount of zakat on various items using the nisab and rate in groups, make charts and display

• Critical Thinking and Problem Solving: interpretation and inference enhanced as learners discuss the measures that can be

put in place to address the challenges of zakat collection and distribution in groups and present in class

• Digital literacy: interacting with digital technology and connecting with technology enhanced as learners search online on

the collection and distribution of zakat in Kenya and make notes
